show.description: In a glittering high-rise society where status is everything, a brutal misunderstanding spirals into a nightmare. When Bollywood superstar Kritika Kapoor collapses alone in her apartment due to a life-threatening illness, her fiancé—Arjun Sabarwal, a secretive billionaire and CEO of a fast-growing delivery empire—rushes to save her, disguised as a delivery boy.
